newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Astro rejoins lists at A$3.045.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Astro rejoins lists at A$3.045.

text.p: Shares in Joe Gutnick-controlled gold and diamond explorer Astro Mining NL rejoined the Australian Stock Exchange lists at A$3.045.
The company was suspended in May 1994 pending clarification of its diamond interests and for failing to meet minimum shareholder spread requirements.

The shares last traded at 62 cents on May 3, 1994. Astro said on September 12 that a placement of placement of 35 million shares at an issue price of 20 cents per share, underwritten to 17.5 million shares by Bell Securities, had been completed.

Gutnick company Edensor Nominees has emerged with 24.48 percent of Astro's capital. By 11.50 a.m. (0150 GMT), Astro shares were at A$4.10 after reaching an intraday high of A$4.25 on turnover of 1.9 million shares.
